title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain DePaul University
description: An under-21-safe guide to the late-night dining rituals that sustain DePaul students across the Lincoln Park and Loop campuses.

cards.title: SocialBites at the Student Center
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late Dining
cards.notes: Visit the second floor of the Lincoln Park Student Center for late-night tacos, burgers, and hot chicken until 10:30 PM most weeknights.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus late-night dining hub in Lincoln Park featuring multiple fast-casual concepts.
cards.evidence_claim: SocialBites is open Monday-Thursday until 10:30 PM and Sunday until 10:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Location & Hours | Dining | DePaul University, Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:30 PM Mon-Thu; 10:00 PM Sun.

cards.title: Devil Dawgs South Loop
cards.subtitle: Loop Campus Staple
cards.notes: Stop by for a late-night Chicago-style dog or the signature Elvis Slider near the DePaul Center and University Center.
cards.short_summary: A popular hot dog and burger joint serving the South Loop campus community with late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The South Loop location is open until 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: South Loop | Hours + Location - Devil Dawgs
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies Lincoln Park
cards.subtitle: Post-Study Sweet Run
cards.notes: Walk over for warm cookies or ice cream sandwiches; this location serves the Lincoln Park campus well into the early morning.
cards.short_summary: A late-night bakery specializing in warm cookie delivery and walk-up service near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lincoln Park location at 2260 N Lincoln Ave is open until 3:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM every night for walk-ins and delivery.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on Lincoln
cards.subtitle: Chicken Finger Cravings
cards.notes: Head to this Lincoln Avenue spot for a Box Combo after late library sessions; it's a frequent stop for Lincoln Park residents.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chain known for chicken fingers, located a short walk from the DePaul Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The location at 2376 N Lincoln Ave is open until 1:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Chicago, IL - N Lincoln Ave

cards.title: 7-Eleven on Lincoln
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Essentials Run
cards.notes: The ultimate 24-hour destination for snacks, drinks, and quick hot food items right on the edge of the Lincoln Park campus.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store providing round-the-clock access to food and supplies for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 2600 N Lincoln Ave is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Ghareeb Nawaz Lincoln Park
cards.subtitle: Affordable Late-Night Indian
cards.notes: Grab a budget-friendly chili chicken paratha or biryani at this Lincoln Park outpost, a favorite for late-night study fuel.
cards.short_summary: A Chicago institution known for generous portions of Pakistani and Indian street food at low prices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lincoln Park location is open until 12:00 AM daily.

cards.title: Velvet Taco Gold Coast
cards.subtitle: Red Line Taco Run
cards.notes: Take the Red Line a few stops south for late-night fusion tacos; it's a popular destination for students after evening events.
cards.short_summary: A trendy taco spot offering creative globally-inspired fillings with very late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gold Coast location is open until 4:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 4:00 AM Fri-Sat; 1:00 AM Sun-Thu.

cards.title: Dunkin' on Chicago Ave
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Coffee Fix
cards.notes: A reliable 24-hour stop for coffee and donuts, situated conveniently for students moving between the Loop and Lincoln Park.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour coffee and donut shop providing a consistent late-night study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 10 W Chicago Ave is open 24 hours.

cards.title: Pick Me Up Cafe
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Diner Vibes
cards.notes: A short trip north to Lakeview offers this eclectic cafe with plenty of vegan options and a classic late-night atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing Chicago cafe known for its late hours and inclusive menu for vegetarians and vegans.
cards.evidence_claim: Open until 12:00 AM or later most nights, including 2:00 AM on Fridays.
cards.source_title: Pick Me Up Cafe | Chicago, IL
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM on Fridays and 1:00 AM on Saturdays.

cards.title: P.O.D. Market
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Convenience
cards.notes: Located in the Student Center, this is the go-to for late-night snacks and essentials using Blue Demon Dollars.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus convenience store providing late-night access to groceries and prepared snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The P.O.D. Market in the Student Center is open until 10:30 PM Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Location & Hours | Dining | DePaul University, Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:30 PM Mon-Thu; 10:00 PM Sun.
